        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Measure</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Success</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      </bpmn:lane>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start" name="Measurements needed" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Accept" name="Request accepted?" default="F_Accept_Yes" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Deny" name="Deny the request" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Measure" name="Perform the measurement" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Success" name="Reading successful?" default="F_Success_Yes" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformFailure" name="Inform the GO about the failure of the reading" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TransmitValues" name="Transmit the measured values to the GO" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Process" name="Process the measured values" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendChanged" name="Send the changed values to the MSP" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TransmitSP" name="Transmit the readings to the SP" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Done" name="Readings transmitted" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Denied" name="Request denied" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Failed" name="Reading failed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="Start" targetRef="Task_Request" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="Task_Request" targetRef="Task_Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="Task_Check" targetRef="Gw_Accept" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Accept_Yes" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_Accept" targetRef="Task_Measure" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Accept_No" name="no" sourceRef="Gw_Accept" targetRef="Task_Deny" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="Task_Deny" targetRef="End_Denied" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="Task_Measure" targetRef="Gw_Success" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Success_Yes" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_Success" targetRef="Task_TransmitValues" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Success_No" name="no" sourceRef="Gw_Success" targetRef="Task_InformFailure" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10" sourceRef="Task_InformFailure" targetRef="End_Failed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11" sourceRef="Task_TransmitValues" targetRef="Task_Process" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F12" sourceRef="Task_Process" targetRef="Task_SendChanged" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F13" sourceRef="Task_SendChanged" targetRef="Task_TransmitSP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F14" sourceRef="Task_TransmitSP" targetRef="End_Done" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
